follow-up time: Varies, up to the end of the study period (March 2022)
exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection in the third trimester
severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus-2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection
cohort: 1609 pregnant women evaluated for emergency care, labour and delivery, respiratory symptoms, obstetric reasons, or medical reasons
finding: COVID-19 infection, particularly during the third trimester, was significantly associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity and mortality, while vaccination was found to be protective.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity and mortality.
